seasonalIntro: Seasonal Events in Fallout 76 are rotating events available for a short time, usually one or two weeks. Seasonal Events are scheduled in advance and are announced on the Fo76 Community Calendar. Some of these events coincide with real holidays, such as the Holiday Scorched event around Christmas or Spooky Scorched around Halloween.

Certain Seasonal Events, like Fasnacht Day or Mothman Equinox, feature a thematically appropriate Public Event. Others, such as Spooky Scorched or Treasure Hunter, introduce special types of enemies that drop event rewards.
Here you will find a list of all Seasonal Events in Fallout 76:
weekendIntro: Weekend Events in Fallout 76 are small events that typically run from Thursday to Monday. Unlike Seasonal Events, these do not feature special Public Events or unique opponents. Instead, players receive various bonuses, such as double XP during Double XP weekends or double Gold Bullion during Gold Rush weekends.
Here you will find a list of all Weekend Events in Fallout 76:

details.title: Fasnacht Day
details.description: Fasnacht Day is a seasonal event in Fallout 76 that is happening once or twice a year. During the event period, the Public Event “Fasnacht Day” takes place once every hour in Helvetia.

details.title: The Big Bloom
details.description: The Big Bloom is a seasonal event in Fallout 76, normally occurring once a year in the springtime. During the event period, the Public Event “The Big Bloom” takes place once every hour at Susan’s Cabin in Skyline Valley.
details.imageAlt: The Big Bloom event in Fallout 76

details.title: Meat Week
details.description: Meat Week is a seasonal event in Fallout 76 normally occurring once a year. During the event period, the Public Event “Grahm’s Meat Cook” takes place once every hour and the Public Event “Primal Cuts” takes place every 15 minutes.

details.title: Spooky Scorched
details.description: Spooky Scorched is the annual Halloween Event in Fallout 76. During the event, you have a chance to encounter legendary Spooky Scorched carrying rare rewards. Trick or Treat is also part of the event.

details.title: Holiday Scorched
details.description: Holiday Scorched is the annual Christmas Event in Fallout 76. During the event, you have a chance to encounter legendary Holiday Scorched carrying gifts that contain special Holiday rewards.

details.title: Mothman Equinox
details.description: The Mothman Equinox is a seasonal event occurring once a year. During the event period, the Public Event “The Mothman Equinox” takes place once every hour in Point Pleasant.
details.imageAlt: The Mothman Equinox event in Fo76

details.title: Invaders from Beyond
details.description: Invaders from Beyond is a season event occurring once a year. During the event period, the Public Event “Invaders from Beyond” takes place in one of 6 possible locations.
details.imageAlt: Fallout 76 Invaders from Beyond Seasonal Event

details.title: The Hunt for the Treasure Hunter
details.description: The Hunt for the Treasure Hunter is a series of limited-time Fallout 76 events, that take place several times a year. During the event, you can hunt down legendary Treasure Hunter Mole Miners and claim their loot.

details.title: Scrip Surplus
details.description: You’ll get double the daily Scrip from Legendary Exchange Machines.

details.title: Double Score
details.description: You’ll get double the Score points from Daily Challenges.

details.title: Gold Rush
details.description: You’ll get double the daily Gold Bullion from turning in Treasury Notes.

details.title: Murmrgh’s Special Pick
details.description: Buy “Murmrgh’s Special Pick” from Purveyor Murmrgh at the Rusty Pick to get a randomly selected 3-star weapon and armor.

details.title: Legendary Vendor Sale
details.description: 25% off at Purveyor Murmrgh’s in the Rusty Pick.

details.title: Double XP
details.description: You’ll get double the XP from all XP-granting activities.

details.title: Double Mutations
details.description: Daily Ops enemies have a unique combination of two different mutations. Daily Ops give better rewards and double XP.

details.title: Caps-A-Plenty
details.description: You’ll get double the daily Caps from vendors.
